description: Validate that experiments form a closed loop: design → run → result → hypothesis status transition

experiment.claim_being_tested: Enterprise devs will pay $50/month for this tool
experiment.decision_rule: If ≥40%: proceed with $50 pricing. If <20%: test $25. If 20-40%: test $35.
experiment.risk_check: Survey bias risk; mitigate with randomized pricing anchor
experiment.instrumentation: Typeform survey with pricing Ladder; export to CSV

experiment.claim_being_tested: Data scientists are the primary user segment
experiment.method: Landing page test with segment-specific messaging
experiment.success_threshold: ≥60% of signups from data scientist persona
experiment.failure_threshold: <30% of signups from data scientist persona
experiment.decision_rule: If <30%: discard H2; generate new segment hypothesis
experiment.risk_check: Landing page traffic may not represent target market
experiment.result: 22% of signups from data scientist persona; 45% from backend engineers

cases.expected_gate_impact: RECYCLE — generate new segment hypothesis for backend engineers

experiment.decision_rule: If <4hr: claim validated. If >6hr: claim disproven. If 4-6hr: inconclusive, extend pilot.
experiment.risk_check: Small sample; pilot customers may not be representative
experiment.instrumentation: Time tracking via product analytics; weekly check-in calls

cases.expected_gate_impact: CONDITIONAL GO — extend pilot for more data
